title: The home note
summary: Return to the start and listen.

steps.title: The home note
steps.body:
**tonic** means the home note of a scale, the note it starts from and returns to. In C major, C is the tonic. Listen to the whole scale, then finish on C again.

**Why it matters:** Knowing the home note helps you hear where a tune feels settled.

steps.title: Find the notes
steps.body: The low C3 and high C4 are both called C. The scale returns to its home letter at the higher octave.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Play C, D, E, then return to C. Compare stopping on D with stopping on C; listen rather than rushing.
